# pomodorotimer.one

> A free, no-signup online Pomodoro timer for focus and productivity, with study/coding-specific variants and guides on the Pomodoro Technique.

## Main tool
- [Pomodoro Timer](https://pomodorotimer.one/): customizable focus timer, task list, session stats
- [25 Minute Timer](https://pomodorotimer.one/25-minute-timer.html)
- [50/10 Timer](https://pomodorotimer.one/50-10-timer.html)
- [Study Timer](https://pomodorotimer.one/study-timer.html)
- [Coding Timer](https://pomodorotimer.one/coding-timer.html)
- [Timer with Music](https://pomodorotimer.one/pomodoro-timer-with-music.html)

## Guides
- [What is the Pomodoro Technique?](https://pomodorotimer.one/pomodoro-technique.html)
- [The Pomodoro Technique: Complete Guide](https://pomodorotimer.one/blog-pomodoro-technique-guide.html)
- [Focus Tips for Developers](https://pomodorotimer.one/blog-focus-tips-for-developers.html)
- [Best Study Methods](https://pomodorotimer.one/blog-best-study-methods.html)
